citations.assessment: An anonymous Galilean teaches in Rav Chisda’s presence. The repeated geographic description does not settle whether the two traditions concern the same person.
A Galilean is asked by plural speakers to teach the Chariot; a wasp emerges from the wall. Heilprin compresses the speech attribution and omits what follows.
